DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-gastrectomy internal hernia with metabolic acidosis.

The combination of acute confusion, vomiting, abdominal pain, and your recent sleeve gastrectomy strongly suggests a surgical complication like an internal hernia causing bowel obstruction, complicated by diabetic ketoacidosis or severe electrolyte imbalance.
